claims.text: Accurate probability estimates for multiclass problems can be obtained by combining calibrated binary probability estimates.
Calibrated two-class probability estimates can be produced for any classifier that generates a ranking of examples.

evidence.description: Experimental evaluation using naive Bayes and support vector machine classifiers across direct marketing, text categorization, and digit recognition domains.
Experimental evaluation using naive Bayes and support vector machine classifiers on various two-class domains.

methodologies.name: Multiclass Calibration via Binary Combination
methodologies.description: A method that transforms classifier outputs into multiclass probability estimates by combining calibrated binary probability estimates.

methodologies.name: Ranking-based Two-Class Calibration
methodologies.description: A method that converts scores from ranking classifiers into calibrated binary probability estimates.

limitations.text: Previous calibration methods apply only to two-class problems.
